manufacture--noun.def: The process of making goods in a factory.
manufacture--noun.ex: The manufacture of glass began here.

manufacture--verb.def: To make goods in large numbers in a factory.

casually--adv.def: In a relaxed way, or without seeming to care.

multiply--verb.def: To add a number to itself, or to increase greatly.

divert--verb.def: To make something travel a different way.

reasonably--adv.def: In a fair way, or fairly but not very.

curl--noun.ex: A curl fell over her eye.

navigate--verb.def: To find the way when travelling, or to move through something.

ethnic--adj.def: Relating to a group with a shared culture and origin.
ethnic--adj.ex: The city has many ethnic groups.

racism--noun.def: Unfair treatment of people because of their race.

stingy--adj.def: Unwilling to spend or give money.
stingy--adj.ex: Do not be stingy with the sauce.

anticipation--noun.def: The feeling of looking forward to something.

paralysis--noun.def: The loss of the ability to move part of the body.

compassionate--adj.def: Feeling and showing sympathy for others.

colon--noun.def: The punctuation mark before a list, or part of the gut.
colon--noun.ex: Put a colon before the list.

uncommon--adj.def: Not happening or seen very often.

ironically--adv.def: In a way that is the opposite of what you expect.

cello--noun.def: A large string instrument played sitting down.

orchid--noun.def: A flower with an unusual shape and bright colours.

jeopardize--verb.def: To put something good at risk.

axis--noun.def: A line around which something turns, or a line on a graph.
axis--noun.ex: The earth turns on its axis.

participation--noun.def: The act of taking part in something.

blooming--adj.def: Producing flowers, or looking very healthy.
blooming--adj.ex: The blooming trees line the street.

refresh--noun.def: The act of updating what is shown on a screen.

compatible--adj.def: Able to work or exist together.

malaria--noun.def: A serious illness spread by mosquitoes.

overthrow--verb.def: To remove a government or a leader by force.

obsessive--adj.def: Thinking about something far too much.

respiratory--adj.def: Relating to breathing and the lungs.

strand--noun.def: A single thin piece of hair, thread or wire.
strand--noun.ex: A strand of hair fell loose.

prosper--verb.ex: The town prospered after the road opened.

export--verb.def: To sell goods to another country.
export--verb.ex: They export olive oil to Europe.

conceive--verb.def: To think of a plan, or to become pregnant.
conceive--verb.ex: He conceived the idea in prison.

projection--noun.def: An estimate of a future figure.

editorial--noun.def: An article giving a newspaper's own opinion.

shatter--verb.def: To break suddenly into very small pieces.
shatter--verb.ex: The mirror shattered on the floor.

endurance--noun.def: The ability to keep going despite difficulty.

disrupt--verb.def: To stop something from continuing normally.

adventurous--adj.def: Willing to try new and risky things.

expectation--noun.def: A belief that something will happen.

paramedic--adj.def: Relating to trained staff who give emergency care.
paramedic--adj.ex: A paramedic team reached the scene.
paramedic--adj.exTr: Bir sağlık ekibi olay yerine ulaştı.

inflation--noun.def: A general rise in prices over time.

irritated--adj.def: Slightly angry, or sore and red.

worldly--adj.def: Relating to material life rather than the spirit.

checkpoint--noun.def: A place where vehicles are stopped and checked.

disposition--noun.def: A person's usual character and mood.

enforce--verb.def: To make people obey a law or a rule.

imply--verb.def: To suggest something without saying it directly.

conception--noun.def: An idea or understanding of something.
conception--noun.ex: He has no conception of the cost.

catalog--noun.def: A list of goods or items with details.

proximity--noun.def: The state of being near something.

unavailable--adj.def: Not able to be obtained or not free to meet.

innovation--noun.def: A new idea or method that is introduced.

paradox--noun.def: A statement that seems to contradict itself but may be true.

conversion--noun.def: The act of changing something into another form.

blindly--adv.def: Without thinking or without being able to see.

formerly--adv.ex: The hall was formerly a church.

desirable--adj.def: Worth having and wanted by many people.

imitation--noun.def: A copy of something, or the act of copying.
imitation--noun.ex: The bag is a cheap imitation.

latter--adj.def: The second of two things just mentioned.

inquire--verb.def: To ask for information, in formal English.

listener--noun.def: A person who listens, especially to radio.
listener--noun.ex: A listener sent in the question.

juror--noun.def: A member of a jury in a court.

mortar--noun.def: The mixture that holds bricks together, or a heavy gun.
mortar--noun.ex: The mortar between the bricks crumbled.

correspondent--noun.def: A journalist who reports from a particular place.

outskirts--noun.def: The outer parts of a town, away from the centre.
